data.name: Mail_Failure_Subject
data.value: MailVault: mailbox “{0}” could not be archived

data.name: Mail_Failure_Body
data.value:
Hello,
MailVault Home failed to retrieve the mailbox “{0}” ({1}) {2} times in a row.
Error: {3}
Last successful retrieval: {4} Last attempt: {5} Schedule: {6}
What you can do: - Changed your password? Open the profile in MailVault and enter the new password. - Gmail, iCloud, Yahoo: an app password is required. - GMX/WEB.DE: is IMAP/POP3 access still allowed in the webmail settings? - Is the PC online and the server reachable?
Until the problem is fixed, new emails from this mailbox will not be archived. Nothing was deleted or changed on the server - MailVault only reads.
MailVault reminds you again at most at the configured intervals and lets you know as soon as it works again.

data.name: AiP_Find_1_Text
data.value: Find the email in which someone sent me the Wi-Fi login details for the holiday home.

data.name: AiP_Find_2_Text
data.value: Last spring a tradesman sent me a quote for new windows – I no longer remember the name. Find it and summarize the quote.

data.name: AiP_Find_3_Text
data.value: Where is the PDF with my rental agreement? Name the email and the file name of the attachment.

data.name: AiP_Find_4_Text
data.value: List all booking confirmations (flights, hotels, trains) from 2025 as a table: travel date, provider, destination, booking number (last 4 characters only), price – unknown fields as “not found”.

data.name: AiP_Find_5_Text
data.value: Which software licenses, serial numbers or warranty cards have I received by email? Table with product, date, email – do not write out the keys themselves.

data.name: AiP_Money_1_Text
data.value: Create a table of all invoices from [2025]: invoice date, sender, amount, due date, invoice number. Missing details as “not found”, do not estimate anything. Add totals per sender at the end.

data.name: AiP_Money_2_Text
data.value: Which ongoing contracts and subscriptions do I have (electricity, mobile phone, insurance, streaming, magazines)? For each contract: provider, fee, payment frequency, term/notice period, latest email about it.

data.name: AiP_Money_3_Text
data.value: Are there contracts whose notice period ends in the next 3 months? Name the deadline, the provider, how to cancel, and the email as evidence.

data.name: AiP_Money_4_Text
data.value: Find all announcements of price or fee increases from the last 2 years. Old price, new price, effective from when, special right of termination?

data.name: AiP_Money_5_Text
data.value: Collect everything I need for the [2025] tax return: donation receipts, tradesman invoices, insurance certificates, work equipment, training courses. Grouped by category with amounts and evidence.

data.name: AiP_Money_6_Text
data.value: Read the email [#ID] with the contract. Summarize the term, costs, termination, automatic renewal and any unusual or disadvantageous clauses.

data.name: AiP_Money_7_Text
data.value: Are there dunning letters, payment reminders or invoices that look unpaid and were not followed by a payment confirmation?

data.name: AiP_Deadlines_1_Text
data.value: Which appointments and deadlines appear in my emails from the last 3 months? Table: date, what it is about, who is responsible, source [#ID]. Sorted by urgency.

data.name: AiP_Deadlines_2_Text
data.value: Which emails from real people (no newsletters) from the last 4 weeks contain a question or request to me that I apparently have not answered?

data.name: AiP_Deadlines_3_Text
data.value: What have I promised or committed to others in my sent emails ("I'll take care of it", "I'll send it to you")? With date and evidence.

data.name: AiP_Deadlines_4_Text
data.value: For which purchases from the last 2 years is the statutory or manufacturer's warranty about to expire? Purchase date, product, retailer, expiry date (2 years unless stated otherwise – then mark it as an assumption).

data.name: AiP_Connections_1_Text
data.value: Show me everything related to email [#ID] and create a chronology: who wrote what and when, what was decided, what is still open.

data.name: AiP_Connections_2_Text
data.value: Follow the topic [house construction] through the entire archive: key milestones as a timeline with evidence, people and companies involved.

data.name: AiP_Connections_3_Text
data.value: Summarize my entire correspondence with [Name]: since when, how often, main topics, important events, latest status.

data.name: AiP_Connections_4_Text
data.value: Who was involved in planning [family celebration/project], and who took on which task?

data.name: AiP_Connections_5_Text
data.value: For the dispute with [company], compile all relevant emails in chronological order: commitments, complaints, replies, deadlines. Only documented facts, each with [#ID].

data.name: AiP_Analysis_1_Text
data.value: Who are my 15 most important contacts (real people, no newsletters), how has the contact developed over the years, and which groups (family, friends, work, authorities, companies) do they fall into?

data.name: AiP_Analysis_2_Text
data.value: Which people did I use to be in regular contact with, but not for more than a year? When was the last exchange and what was it about?

data.name: AiP_Analysis_3_Text
data.value: Create a review of the year [2025] from my emails: key events per month, trips, purchases, new contacts, email volume.

data.name: AiP_Analysis_4_Text
data.value: Which senders send me the most automated emails (newsletters, advertising, notifications)? List with count per month – candidates for unsubscribing.

data.name: AiP_Analysis_5_Text
data.value: What did I order online in [2025]? Table with date, shop, item, price; total per shop.

data.name: AiP_Analysis_6_Text
data.value: How has the tone in the correspondence with [name/company] changed over time? Back up turning points with emails.

data.name: AiP_Security_1_Text
data.value: Which emails contain passwords, PINs or login details in plain text? Only name the emails and the service, do not reproduce the data itself – so that I can change them.

data.name: AiP_Security_2_Text
data.value: Find emails from the last 6 months that look like phishing (urgent account suspension, parcel customs fees, prize draws, mismatched sender domains) and explain why in each case.

data.name: AiP_Security_3_Text
data.value: Which online services do I have an account with, according to registration and welcome emails? Table: service, sign-up date, email address used.

data.name: AiP_Security_4_Text
data.value: Where have I sent or received ID, tax or insurance numbers by email? Only name where they occur.
